visual_prompt: Square 1:1 minimalist ad on a plain seamless warm cream background (#FBF3DC), no panels, no decorations, the top area left as empty cream space. UPPER TWO THIRDS: three natural, photorealistic studio photos of the same Colombian woman, about 26 years old, light-brown skin, dark hair in a high ponytail, wearing the same outfit in all three (a fitted cream short-sleeve t-shirt and terracotta high-waist leggings), standing side by side in three equal columns, each framed from the knees up, facing the camera, at the same scale, with soft contact shadows. Her body shape, size and proportions are exactly the same in all three photos; only her action and expression change. Left photo: she holds the amber dropper bottle in one hand and the dropper in the other, calm neutral expression. Center photo: she holds a full bowl of breakfast (fruit, oats, eggs) and lifts a spoon to her mouth, smiling with appetite. Right photo: she holds a small dumbbell in one hand with the other hand on her hip, a big energetic smile, a small towel over her shoulder. Directly under each photo, on one shared baseline, a bold black uppercase day label. LOWER THIRD, centered and alone: the product standing front view at eye level with a soft contact shadow. The product is a 60 ml (2 fl oz) amber-brown glass dropper bottle with rounded shoulders and a short neck, topped with a black ribbed screw collar and a glossy black rubber bulb dropper; the glass pipette is visible inside the amber liquid. A wraparound label covers most of the body with a smooth vertical gradient from bright lemon yellow at the top to white / pale silver at the bottom. On the label, from top to bottom: the lowercase black wordmark 'amua', the large white uppercase name 'VITALDROPS', a small dark line 'All-In-One Multi-Herbal Supplement', five small thin-outlined circular ingredient badges in two rows (A, MA, L on the first row; F, BR on the second) with tiny captions, and 'Dietary Supplement 2 fl. oz. (60mL)' at the bottom. The bottle is roughly 2.6 times taller than wide including the dropper. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the product; do not redesign, replace or reinterpret the bottle or its label. The small bottle she holds in the left photo is the same product. Soft even studio lighting, light and warm mood. The only text in the image is the three day labels. No headline, no logo, no price, no CTA button, no icons, no arrows, no badges, no stars.
